description: Audits a project's announced claims against ISO/RTO interconnection queue filings, study stages, and capital commitments, or searches the queue pipeline. Pass a project name, alias, canonical ID, or ISO/RTO filter.

cursor.description: Opaque base64 pagination cursor from a previous search result.

filters.description: Optional structured filters object for project or queue searches.

has_capital_data.description: Filter to projects with disclosed or verified capital data.

include_capital.description: Include AIxEnergy Capital Intelligence commitments and financing events.

include_capital_stack.description: Alias for include_capital to include the project capital stack.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 for proximity search (e.g. 32.7767).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100).

location.description: City, county, or place name for spatial search (e.g. 'Dallas, TX', 'near Phoenix').

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 for proximity search (e.g. -96.7970).

min_capital_usd.description: Minimum disclosed or identified capital in USD (e.g. 1000000000).

min_mw.description: Minimum IT or facility capacity in megawatts (e.g. 200).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Project ID, canonical ID, or slug (e.g. 'CVP0003', 'P017', 'AXP-US-TX-00040').

provenance_type.description: Queue provenance filter separating authentic RTO filings from synthetic mirrors.

query.description: Project name, alias, natural sentence, or search query (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Dallas, TX').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around location or coordinates (e.g. 25).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').
